setup: [a buyer on a marketplace listing wants to finish the deal on [chat app name] instead of the marketplace] [the buyer sends a screenshot as proof that payment was made]
ask: [the buyer, now on [chat app name] and pointing to the payment screenshot, asks the player to ship the item today, or to refund an overpayment to a different account, before the money shows in the player's account]
usualEnding: The screenshot was edited. The item ships, or the refund goes out, and no payment ever lands.
realTwin: A real buyer asks a question about the item inside the marketplace chat, pays through the marketplace, and the payment shows in the player's own account before anything ships.
